basis.what: Operation route and hours: CostVision (headless costMeasuredPart, UK book, AIR_GAPPED) on STEP models MODELLED FROM THE PUBLISHED DRAWING v the recorded TRW 1972 data.
basis.timeBaseCaveat: 1972 standard hours on 1972 US machines (engine / turret / tracer / double-compound lathes, Heald and Bryant internal grinders, a Gleason generator, a 2000 t Maxipress) v CostVision 2026 cycle times on CNC lathes / VMC / hobbers. A ratio here measures method + era + scope together; it is not an accuracy figure for either. Dollars and pounds are NOT compared.
basis.recordedHours: MAN = direct labour standard hours a piece (observed and factored for practical efficiency, or standard data); MACH = machine hours where given; set-up = hours a lot (forging lot 500, machining lot 100).
basis.toolHours: machine h/pc = cycle / OEE (as the core charges it); labour h/pc = crew x labour time / labour efficiency; gear route: set-up 0.75 h an operation a batch is folded into each cycle by the module - split out here (DERIVED); forging route: secondary-machining set-up is its own amortised line (45 min a fixturing / batch = annual/20).
basis.scope: Record stops before carburise/harden; inspection and quality control are indirect (asterisked ops, sec. 8.0 precept 6) - excluded from both sides. Tool lines excluded on that basis: gear grinding (after case hardening), gear inspection, carburise / quench / temper and washes (gear route, £ by weight, no hours), forging quench-temper (£/kg), NDT (£/part), descale (£/kg, no hours). Deburr: Table XXIX item 4 excludes "some deburring operations common to both processes" - tool deburr lines are shown but kept out of the like-for-like totals.

verdicts.operationCoverage: POOR: tool omits all pre-HT grinding (4 gear ops, 1 pinion op), polishing, marking; collapses 7-9 lathe ops into 1 turning + 1 VMC boring line; forging route picks a ring-rolling mill (not a closed-die precision coin press) and has no forged-teeth concept; gear route is a cylindrical hob/grind model - no bevel / spiral-bevel process exists in the tool; with neutral file names the gear is not routed to gear or forging at all.
verdicts.setupStructure: DIFFERENT IN KIND: record = one set-up per op (5 forging / 500-lot incl. 9.0 h press set-up; 11 machining / 100-lot = 19.0 h); tool forging = no forge-line set-up, 1.5 h machining per batch of annual/20; tool gear = 0.75 h per op per batch of annual/12. Per-piece set-up 13-63x lower in the tool.
verdicts.runTimeOrderOfMagnitude: tool 1 to 1.5 orders of magnitude lower: forging 5x, machining 20-38x labour (11-21x machine-h), tooth cutting 23-35x; totals 14x (XXIX), 22x (full XXV), 61x labour / 27x machine-h (conventional). ~2x of the labour ratio is the tool's 0.5 crew; the rest is era/method plus omitted operations.
verdicts.materialInput: forged gear billet: tool 7.91 kg v recorded 7.26 kg (+9%), bar 82.3 v 88.9 mm - close, but reached via a ring-rolling yield; conventional blank and pinion billet not comparable (dollars only / not recorded); tool gear route buys a 12.96 kg bar slice sized from a cylindrical tip Ø 254.7 mm v 226.2 mm real heel OD.

routingProbe_neutralNames: tool-runs/probe/neutral_*.json: with file names part_A/part_B the gear gets "Which process makes this part?" options casting / cast_and_machine (leaning) / machining; the pinion casting / forging / cast_and_machine (leaning) / machining.
